operation_details.item: The user allocates shared IT costs using headcount ratios.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! How's the finance week treating you? I saw the calendar note about the IT cost review coming up.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty good, thanks. Yeah, next month’s review is on my list. We’re finally going to dig into the methodology again.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Remind me, which pieces are included in that allocation? Is it just cloud, or also licensing and stuff?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It covers both cloud and licensing costs. We use headcount ratios to split those across departments.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Headcount ratios—so each team pays based on how many people they have? That must have taken some convincing to get approved.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It did, but the methodology was approved last quarter. The review next month is to check whether it still makes sense.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice, that sounds practical. At least you’ll have a full quarter of actuals to look at before deciding if anything needs adjusting.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. It’s simple and transparent enough, even if it’s not the most precise per-team usage measure.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the headcount-ratio method for IT cost allocation, while keeping the cost scope, approval, and review schedule.
